# St. George Memorials

> Custom headstones, monuments, and memorial markers for Southern Utah families. Cemetery approval guaranteed before every order.

St. George Memorials is a locally managed monument company serving Washington, Iron, Kane, Beaver, and Garfield counties in Southern Utah. Our core differentiator: we contact the cemetery sexton and confirm section-specific rules before quoting any stone. We send a digital design proof at real scale before any payment is due.

## Service Area

Southern Utah only. Five counties:
- **Washington County**: St. George, Hurricane, Ivins, Santa Clara, Washington City, La Verkin, Toquerville, Enterprise, Gunlock, Leeds, New Harmony, Central, Virgin City
- **Iron County**: Cedar City, Enoch, Parowan, Paragonah, Kanarraville, Summit
- **Kane County**: Kanab, Fredonia (AZ border), Orderville, Glendale, Alton, Big Water
- **Beaver County**: Beaver, Milford, Minersville, Adamsville
- **Garfield County**: Panguitch, Tropic, Escalante, Boulder, Cannonville, Hatch

- **Bronze Memorials & VA Markers** — VA-issued bronze markers at no cost for eligible veterans; private bronze plaques also available. https://stgeorgememorials.com/headstones/bronze-memorials

### Specialty: LDS Temple Engravings (Washington County)
Washington County has two LDS temples — the oldest operating temple in the Church (1877) and a 2024 dedication:
- **St. George Utah Temple** (1877, castellated silhouette) — sandblasted line drawing on Barre Gray or laser-etched on jet black. https://stgeorgememorials.com/headstones/st-george-temple-headstones
- **Red Cliffs Utah Temple** (2024, cottonwood-leaf motif) — laser-etched on polished jet black or midnight granite. https://stgeorgememorials.com/headstones/red-cliffs-temple-headstones
- Companion monuments with both temples on one stone are a specialty.

### Additional Services
- **Custom Engraving** — portraits, scripture, military insignia, pioneer motifs (sego lily, beehive, sea gull, handcart). https://stgeorgememorials.com/headstones/custom-engraving
- **Cleaning & Restoration** — pioneer-era sandstone marker restoration, hard-water calcium treatment. https://stgeorgememorials.com/headstones/restoration
- **LDS & Pioneer Motifs** — Cotton Mission heritage designs. https://stgeorgememorials.com/headstones/lds-pioneer-headstones

## Veterans & Southern Utah National Cemetery

SUNC (dedicated September 10, 2025) is the first VA national cemetery in Southern Utah — 45 minutes north of St. George in Cedar City. Eligible veterans receive:
- Free gravesite
- Free government-issued marker (granite flat, marble flat, or bronze)
- Perpetual care
- Military honors at graveside
- Presidential Memorial Certificate

Alternative: For veterans who died on or after November 1, 1990, the VA issues a bronze medallion (VA Form 40-1330M) for affixing to a private headstone. This allows full custom design with VA recognition in a hometown cemetery.

We help families choose between both paths without pushing the more expensive option.

Every quote includes: granite, engraving, digital design proof, sexton coordination, required concrete apron, freight, professional setting, first-year maintenance cleaning at six months. Full pricing guide: https://stgeorgememorials.com/resources/pricing

## Process

1. **Tell us your cemetery** — section, block, row if known
2. **We call the sexton** — written confirmation of dimensions, base requirements, section-specific rules
3. **You approve the proof** — digital design at real scale; nothing goes to production without written sign-off
4. **Fabrication and setting** — manufacture, freight to cemetery, concrete apron pour, set under sexton supervision; first cleaning at 6 months included

Timeline: 10–18 weeks typical. Year-round installation in St. George Valley (no winter freeze). Rush option: subtract ~3 weeks for $200–$400 add-on.

## Snowbird / Out-of-State Ordering

Washington County is a top-10 US snowbird destination. We design, coordinate, and install entirely remotely — design proof by email, sexton calls handled, monument freighted directly to the cemetery. Families never need to be present. No upcharge for out-of-state coordination.

## Climate & Material Notes

Southern Utah environment: 300+ sunny days/year, UV intensity at elevation, calcium-rich hard water, red-rock dust. Recommendations:
- **Jet Black or Midnight Black polished granite** — best UV resistance, hides hard-water spotting, highest contrast for laser etch
- **Dakota Mahogany** — for families wanting warm red-rock tone
- **No marble** — weathers too quickly in desert UV and hard water
- Polished finish required (resists mineral absorption)
